payloadStrategy.description:
The strategy to employ on payloads when forwarding actions.
`OVERRIDE`: Override the original payload in the action to be this `UIEffectPayloadCarrier.payload` (default behavior)
`MERGE`: Merges the original payload and `UIEffectPayloadCarrier.payload` giving preference to `UIEffectPayloadCarrier.payload`

trigger.description:
Trigger associated with UiSdlEffectTrigger.
The trigger can be either the full action type name including the id of the reduxable.
If the id is not specified, then it is assumed that the trigger is listening on the same
reduxable where the trigger is defined.

effectType.description:
{@link UiSdlEpic} denoting type of UiSdlEffectTrigger. Will be set only if actions field is not set.
Has higher priority than actions field.
`payload` and `payloadStrategy` fields that are inherited from {@link UiSdlEffectPayloadForwarder} will only be used when `effectType` is set

If multiple effects point to the same {@link UiSdlEffectTrigger#trigger} from different files, their
order of execution is non-deterministic.

actions.description:
Collection of {@link UiSdlEffectActionSpec}. Will be set only if effectType field is not set.
Each {@link UiSdlEffectActionSpec} will be dispatched in the natural order of the collection.

If multiple {@link UiSdlEffectActionSpec} point to the same {@link UiSdlEffectTrigger#trigger} from different files, their
order of execution is non-deterministic.

comment.description: Used to document complex effectTriggers. Ignored while rendering the component.
